summary: This Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A. announces the board approval of the company's 9th issuance of simple, non-convertible, senior unsecured debentures in a single series, with an aggregate principal amount of R$800 million and an overallotment option of up to 25% (total up to R$1 billion). The debentures have a 10-year term maturing June 15, 2036, with semi-annual interest, annual amortization starting in year 8, and a yield capped at the greater of NTN-B 2035 or IPCA+7.66% p.a. The offering is a public distribution under automatic registration targeting professional investors in Brazil. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
